scope: All 500000 launched records per block; independently rebuild eligible from first-visit entry/exit geometry and exit momentum, then compare every eligible record in exact ledger order with saved score catalog arrays. No model inference or active generation/scoring calls.
ULP_definition: float64(p32) - float64(nextafter(p32, -infinity, dtype=float32)); margin32 is computed as float32(p32-y32), then promoted to float64 for ratios and summaries
threshold_rule: Count 0 < margin <= threshold; report exact zero and negative separately. Thresholds are cumulative, not disjoint bins.
quantile_method: NumPy linear, after promotion to float64
momentum_groups: Existing seven physical diagnostic bins from linspace(0.3,1,8), left-closed/right-open except final closed; not conditioner coarse bins.
production_cast: Read saved delta_p_GeV_c as float64, convert p_in and y independently to float32 (matching torch.as_tensor(...,dtype=torch.float32)), then subtract in float32. Also independently recompute y64=p64-pout64 and compare to saved y before repeating cast.
permitted_outputs: Aggregate JSON/Markdown/CSV and provenance hashes only under _support_audit_20261108; no raw/cache/model/prediction files copied or modified.
